hero.title: Building the digital future of
hero.description: Trustora is the Romanian platform that connects entrepreneurs with top IT experts. Our mission is to democratize access to high-quality IT services and support the growth of the local tech ecosystem.

mission.title: We remove the barriers between vision and execution
mission.description: We believe every idea deserves to become reality. That’s why we built Trustora — a platform that removes the barriers between vision and execution by connecting entrepreneurs with the right IT experts.

points.title: Accessibility
points.description: High-quality IT services at fair prices for businesses of all sizes.

points.title: Transparency
points.description: Clear process, transparent pricing, and open communication.

points.title: Excellence
points.description: High standards of quality and guaranteed satisfaction.

vision.title: Become the reference platform
vision.description: for IT services in Eastern Europe, focused on trust, transparency, and sustainable collaboration.

values.title: Principles that build trust
values.description: The principles that guide everything we do and help us build trusted relationships with clients and partners.

items.title: Trust & Security
items.description: All transactions are secured, and providers are verified so you can collaborate with confidence.

items.title: Exceptional Quality
items.description: We work only with experts with proven experience and outstanding client feedback.

items.title: Efficiency & Speed
items.description: Our platform is optimized to match you quickly with the right experts for your project.

items.title: Dedicated Support
items.description: Our team is available 24/7 to help you throughout the collaboration.

timeline.title: Our story
timeline.description: From a simple idea to the trusted platform for thousands of Romanian entrepreneurs.

items.title: Trustora founded
items.description: We launched the platform with the vision of connecting Romanian IT talent to global opportunities.

items.title: First million in transactions
items.description: We reached the first million in processed transactions, confirming market demand.

items.title: National expansion
items.description: We expanded services to all major cities in Romania, reaching over 500 verified experts.

items.title: International recognition
items.description: We were recognized as the most innovative IT services platform in Eastern Europe.

items.title: The digital future
items.description: We continue to innovate with AI and automation to improve the user experience.
